manifest.name: dsh-packer
manifest.description: Packs Skills, sessions, installed plugins and settings into one zip and restores them on a new machine; sanitize or encrypt sensitive content.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test

bundle.text:
# dsh-packer bundle patch: mount the agent-config packer.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-packer
      name: dsh-packer

readme.text:
> **Agent 配置打包器**：把 Skills、会话、已装插件和设置封成一个 zip，换电脑时一键开箱；敏感内容先脱敏或加密。
>
> [简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

> **v0.7.2** · MIT License · DSH 0.2.x（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，0.2.1-rc.3 桌面版实测）· Node ≥ 22.19.0

dsh-packer 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）的「Agent 配置打包器」插件：把本地 Agent 资产按模块打包成标准 zip，用于两种场景：

- **迁移** —— 换机器或重装后，把整套环境完整搬过去。
- **分享** —— 把 Skills 等资产交给别人，敏感内容自动拦截。

打包内容可按模块自由组合（Skills / 会话 / 附件 / Profile / 设置 / 预设 / 记忆），恢复带差异对比与冲突策略，隐私安全扫描全程护航——全部能力按需开启。

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 模块化打包 | 九个模块任意组合：`skills` / `sessions` / `attachments`（**会话里图片/附件的字节**，迁移默认带上）/ `profiles` / `plugins`（**已安装插件的本体**，默认迁移带上）/ `settings` / `presets` / `memory`（Markdown 镜像）/ `memoryDb`（**记忆真库 SQLite 一致快照**，默认带上） |
| 双模式预设 | **迁移**（全选，含已装插件本体与会话附件）/ **分享**（只勾 Skills，自动排除会话、附件、记忆、插件与个人 skill 子目录） |
| 隐私扫描 + **真处理** | 检测盘符 / Unix / UNC 路径、用户目录路径、疑似密钥赋值、密钥形状（`sk-`、`ghp_`、`AKIA`、JWT）、个人昵称；命中后**不再只是提示**，打包页给两选：**清理后打包**（只改包内副本：路径→占位符、密钥→`<已移除的密钥>`，源文件不动；分享模式强制）/ **不清理直接打包**（保真，靠口令保护；含凭据又未加密时明确告警） |
| 脱敏安全兜底 | 单遍最左扫描 + 结构字符排除 → 不会吃掉引号/括号/逗号；`.json`/`.jsonl` 脱敏后真跑解析校验、行数缩进必须不变，否则**整文件回退原文**并记 warning；非 UTF-8 文件不脱敏。限制：YAML 无解析器证明（零依赖），极端写法仍可能产生语义差异 |
| 文件级操作预览 | 打包前预览完整文件清单；恢复前差异报告（新增 / 变更 / 相同 / 跳过） |
| 恢复冲突三选 | 覆盖 / 跳过 / 内容合并（合并 = 追加，绝不覆盖已有内容） |
| 恢复安全写入 | 先备份目标到 packs 目录下的 `.restore-backups/<时间戳>/`，写临时文件后 `rename` **原子替换**；任一环节失败即**中止并回滚**已替换/已新增的文件 |
| 清单完整性校验 | `manifest.json` 记录 schemaVersion + 每个文件 SHA-256 指纹；恢复前校验源文件与清单一致，**缺指纹或指纹格式非法一律拒绝**（fail-closed） |
| 包管理与备注 | 包列表（时间 / 大小 / 模块 / 备注）、删除、重命名、打包时填写备注 |
| 分享包自动附 README | 自动生成并附带说明包内容的 `README.md` |
| 深色模式适配 | 设置页跟随 DSH 主题（`--dsw-alias-*` 令牌 + 品牌琥珀双色板，双通道探测） |
| 零原生依赖 | **纯 JS 读写标准 zip**（zip.mjs + node:zl

readme.section: 桌面版：按包名安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 打开 DSH 桌面版 → 左侧 **插件** → **加插件**；
2. 在包名输入框填 `dsh-packer`，点 **安装**（安装完自动启用）。

命令行等价：

```bash

readme.section: 把 desktop 换成你的 profile 名
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-packer
```
```bash

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:KLRSL/dsh-packer
```
```bash

dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-packer
```

`dsh plugin` 会自动把安装的包登记到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并挂载补丁；安装完成后重启 DSH。

**安装后验证**：

1. 打开 **设置页 →「配置打包」标签页**——能看到模块勾选界面与包列表，即安装成功；
2. 或在终端运行 `/pack list`——返回包列表（首次使用为空列表或提示暂无包），即命令已注册；
3. 再跑一次 `/pack create --dry-run`——不生成真实 zip，仅预览文件清单与扫描结果，确认各模块路径可读。
```bash

readme.section: 1. 创建迁移包（默认全选模块）
readme.text: /pack create --note "迁移到新机器"

readme.section: 2. 或创建分享包（只含 Skills，自动排除敏感内容）
readme.text: /pack create --share --note "分享给朋友"

readme.section: 3. 先预览再打包（不生成 zip）
readme.text:
/pack create --mode migrate --dry-run
```

打包完成后，zip 写入 `~/.dsh/packs/`（`DSH_PACKS_DIR` 可覆盖）；分享包自动附带 `README.md`。
```bash
/pack restore ~/.dsh/packs/dsh-packer-2026-09-05-223045-migrate.zip

readme.section: 3. 指定冲突策略：overwrite | skip | merge
readme.text:
/pack restore <zip路径> --strategy merge
```

恢复前自动校验 `manifest.json`（schemaVersion + 每条指纹的合法性 + 每个源文件的 SHA-256），确认差异报告后按策略应用；写入前先备份、`rename` 原子替换，失败即中止回滚。完成按需重启 DSH。

| 模块 | 内容 | 迁移预设 | 分享预设 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | Skills（含记忆机制 skill），位于 `~/.dsh/skills` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sessions` | 会话记录（`.zstd` 格式），位于 `~/.dsh/sessions` | ✅ | ❌ |
| `attachments` | **会话附件对象库**：会话里的图片/文件字节（内容寻址，位于 `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects`；不含可重建的请求图片缓存与 `tmp` 暂存） | ✅ | ❌ |
| `profiles` | Profile 配置（不含 `node_modules`），位于 `~/.dsh/profiles` | ✅ | ❌ |
| `plugins` | **已安装插件本体**（`profiles/<profile>/node_modules` 的一级包目录），体积大 | ✅ | ❌ |
| `settings` | 全局设置（`settings.yaml`） | ✅ | ❌ |
| `presets` | Agent 预设（`.agent-presets`） | ✅ | ❌ |
| `memory` | **记忆镜像**（Markdown 只读副本，位于 `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` 或 `~/.dsh/memory`；不含 `backups/`） | ✅ | ❌ |
| `memoryDb` | **记忆真库**（`<DSH_BIOMEMORY_DIR \|\| ~/.dsh/biomemory>/biomemory.db`）：打包时用 `VACUUM INTO` 取**一致快照**（只读连接、不碰运行中的 WAL），快照失败则该文件不进包并计入 `unreadable` | ✅ | ❌ |

**会话里的图片在 `attachments`**：会话日志里的图片只是 `attachmentId` 引用（`sha256:<64hex>`），字节在 `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects`。只备份 `sessions` 的话，恢复后的会话里图片会裂（能打开历史，但图取不到字节）；设置页选**「会话记录」组**（= `sessions` + `attachments`）会一起打包。对象是内容寻址的，目标机不需要改写任何引用。

**双模式预设**：

- **迁移** —— 全部模块默认勾选，适合搬迁整套环境。
- **分享** —— 只勾 `skills`；会话、附件与记忆数据自动排除，个人 skill 子目录（`_shared`）在分享时也会排除，让敏感内容尽可能少进包。

| 规则 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 本地绝对路径（盘符） | 盘符形式路径，如 `D:\...`、`C:/...` |
| Unix 家目录路径 | `/home/<名>/...`、`/Users/<名>/...`、`/root/...`——**只认家目录**（路径里含「这是谁的目录」）。`/usr`、`/etc`、`/var`、`/opt`、`/srv`、`/mnt`、`/media`、`/tmp` 是系统公共路径，不含个人信息，v0.7.0 起**不再计入命中、也不再脱敏** |
| UNC / 网络路径 | `\\服务器\共享\...` |
| 用户目录路径 | 操作系统用户配置文件目录下的路径（`C:\Users\<名>`、`/home/<名>`、`/Users/<名>`）；家目录之前的挂载前缀也一并吃掉（`/System/Volumes/Data/Users/<名>/…`、`/Volumes/<卷名>/Users/<名>/…`、`/mnt|media/<名>/Users/<名>/…`），不会留下半截前缀 |
| 挂载卷 / 派生路径 | `/Volumes/<卷名>`、`/System/Volumes/Data`、`/private`、`/nix/store`——这些是**本机特有**的（卷名由用户自定、`/private` 含逐机不同的哈希、`/nix/store` 暴露本机包布局），与 `/usr` `/etc` 这类**任何机器都一样**的系统公共路径不同，替换为 `<本机路径>` 并保留子路径 |
| 疑似密钥 / Token 赋值 | `api_key`、`access_key`、`secret`、`password`、`token`、`bearer`、`authorization`、`credential` 等赋值——**带引号或不带引号**都算 |
| 密钥形状 | 裸密钥本身：`sk-...`、`ghp_...`、`github_pat_...`、`glpat-...`、`AKIA...`、`xox?-...`、JWT（`eyJ.....*.*`） |
| 个人昵称 | 用户昵称文本（由部署者通过 `config.personalPatterns` 注入） |

计数口径：同一**行**内同一规则出现多处会如实累计（不会每规则只算 1 处）；同一处若被多条规则命中，各规则各自上报一次（扫描宁可多报，不漏报）。注意**扫描与脱敏口径不同**：脱敏是单遍最左扫描 + 区间去重，同一个片段只替换一次，不会出现占位符套占位符。

扫描缓存：界面「先预览」与「开始打包」打的是同一个 `/create`，后端按「文件名 + 内容 SHA-256」缓存扫描结论，同一批内容不会被整篇读两遍；**内容一变指纹就变、立即重扫**，所以这是性能优化而不是正确性妥协（没有 SHA-256 的调用不进缓存；部署者改动个人敏感词后缓存整体失效）。

**拦截策略**：

- **分享模式** —— **命中不拦截，但强制脱敏**：忽略界面上传入的 `sanitize` 值一律按「清理后打包」处理（路径→占位符、密钥→`<已移除的密钥>`，只改包内副本、源文件不动）。分享包是给别人用的，宁可改内容也不放行原文。分享模式下**真正会打包失败**的是两类：勾了分享预设不允许的模块（**只有 `skills` 允许**，其余一律返回 `share_scope`）；有文件读不出内容、没能经过扫描（fail-closed，明确列出是哪些文件）。
- **迁移模式** —— 仅报告不拦截，可用 `/pack scan` 或 `--dry-run` 提前查看命中点，自行判断；也可以主动选「清理后打包」。

**永不打包**：`.credentials.yaml`、`.anonymous-user-id`——遍历任何模块时一律跳过，这类本地身份/凭据文件不允许进入任何包（无论迁移还是分享）。

其他安全措施：

- 每个文件的 **SHA-256** 指纹写入 `manifest.json`，恢复时用于完整性校验（fail-closed）；清单条目**缺指纹或指纹格式非法一律拒绝**，不写入指纹的文件在打包时被跳过并如实上报（绝不写空指纹）。
- 恢复对**源路径与目标路径双向**做 containment 校验：源必须在解压目录内，目标必须落在模块目标根内（zip-slip / 篡改清单的 `../` 越界一律拒绝）；绝对路径、盘符路径、UNC 路径、`..` 片段在恢复前就被白名单拒绝。
- 解包前先解析 zip 中央目录做白名单校验（拒绝绝对路径 / 盘符 / UNC / `..`），并拒绝符号链接、硬链接等非普通文件类型；解压后再扫一遍解压结果，出现符号链接即拒绝。临时解压目录统一在 `try/finally` 中清理（成功、失败都不残留）。
- 恢复前先备份目标（`<packs>/.restore-backups/<时间戳>/`），写临时文件后 `rename` 原子替换；任一环节失败即中止并回滚本次已替换/已新增的文件。
- SQLite 库的处理分两侧：**打包**走 `VACUUM INTO` 一致快照（`memoryDb` 模块，v0.2.6 起）——不直接复制被 DSH 持有的 WAL 库，取不到就跳过并计入 `unreadable`；**恢复**默认仍跳过 `*.db*`（`includeDb: true` 才写入），避免覆盖目标机上正在使用的记忆库。

**v0.2.6 起，记忆真库默认就在包里。** 记忆有两个模块，职责不同：

| 模块 | 内容 | 迁移够不够 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryDb` | `<DSH_BIOMEMORY_DIR || ~/.dsh/biomemory>/biomemory.db` 的 **`VACUUM INTO` 一致快照**（含条目与审计） | ✅ 记忆本体 |
| `memory` | `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` 下的 Markdown 只读镜像，供人查看 | ⚠️ 只是可读副本 |

快照用**只读连接**打开源库，产出的是 SQLite 自己保证一致的文件，因此**不必先停 DSH**。
取不到快照（库被独占、磁盘满等）时该文件不进包，并如实出现在 `unreadable` 列表里——绝不退化成“直接复制运行中的库”。

**恢复**时 `memoryDb` 默认**不写入**（避免覆盖目标机正在使用的记忆库）：需要时用 `includeDb: true`（命令行 `/pack restore --include-db`，接口参数同名字段）。
只搬镜像不搬真库＝目标机没有记忆本体。
- 打包文件名带唯一后缀（`dsh-packer-<时间戳>-<随机>-<模式>.zip`），同一秒内多次打包不互相覆盖。
- 打包使用**纯 JS zip 实现**（zip.mjs + node:zlib）生成标准 zip，**零原生 npm 依赖**。
- 文件与子进程操作全部异步（`node:fs/promises` + `execFile`），哈希与复制走有界并发（默认 16 路），大批量打包不会卡住 DSH 的事件循环。

readme.section: 设置页 Web API（`/packer/api/*`）的鉴权与限额
readme.text: 设置页与 `/pack` 命令等价，走插件自己注册的前缀路由 `/packer/api/*`。这条路由的默认姿态是 **fail-closed**——判定顺序为「速率限制 → 鉴权 → 体积 → 路由」，前三步都在**读取请求体之前**完成：

readme.section: 设置页 Web API（`/packer/api/*`）的鉴权与限额
readme.text:
| 项目 | 默认 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 鉴权 | `api.authMode: 'auto'` | **只用官方机制**：`ctx.get('connection')`（dsh-client-connection）的 `requestRejection(req)`——与官方 `/api` 通道同一套 Host/Origin 信任 + 浏览器会话鉴权。返回 `401` → 401，`403` → 403，只有 `undefined` 才放行 |
| 拿不到鉴权服务 | **硬拒绝 403** | `connection` 服务缺失、没有 `requestRejection`、或该调用抛错，一律 403 并说明原因；**不会静默降级**到更弱的通道（要用插件自有令牌，必须显式选 `authMode: 'token'`） |
| 速率限制 | 60 次 / 60 秒 | **最外层**：按客户端地址（`remoteAddress`）滑动窗口，先于鉴权与读体判定，未授权流量同样吃配额。超限回 429 + `retry-after`；键数量有上界（无定时器、内存有界） |
| 请求体上限 | 8 MB | 在**完整缓冲请求体之前**判定：有 `Content-Length` 先比对（超限直接 413，一个字节都不读）；没有长度则边读边累计，一超限立刻解绑监听、暂停连接并回 413 |
| 错误文案 | 出网脱敏 | 服务端绝对路径（盘符 / UNC / Unix 用户目录）统一替换为 `<路径已隐去>`，不回显本机目录结构 |

readme.section: 设置页 Web API（`/packer/api/*`）的鉴权与限额
readme.text:
| 选项 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `authMode` | `'auto'` | `'auto'`：只认官方 `connection`，缺失即 403；`'token'`：**显式 opt-in** 的插件自有回退——Host / Origin / `Sec-Fetch-Site` 同源校验 + 一次性令牌（`apply` 时随机生成，经 `webServer.tapIndex` 注入同源 `index.html`，前端自动带 `x-dsh-packer-token` 头），用于宿主确实没有 `connection` 的场合；`'off'`：**不安全**，仅隔离测试用，真实部署别开 |
| `maxBodyBytes` | `8388608` | 请求体上限（字节） |
| `rateLimit` / `rateWindowMs` | `60` / `60000` | 速率限制次数与窗口（毫秒） |
| `token` | 随机生成 | 仅 `authMode: 'token'` 生效；显式传入便于固定令牌/多实例场景 |

readme.section: 设置页 Web API（`/packer/api/*`）的鉴权与限额
readme.text: `authMode: 'off'` 与显式传入的固定 `token` 都会把安全责任交给部署者，README 记录其存在只为「知道自己选了什么」，不代表推荐。

1. **导入 zip** —— 设置页选择文件，或 `/pack restore <zip路径>`。
2. **解包校验** —— 先列包内成员做白名单校验（绝对路径 / 盘符 / UNC / `..` / 链接类成员一律拒绝），再读 `manifest.json`。
3. **manifest 校验** —— `manifest.json` 存在、schemaVersion 与当前版本兼容、每条清单条目的 SHA-256 指纹存在且合法、每个源文件哈希与清单一致；任一不匹配即 **fail-closed 拒绝**。
4. **差异报告** —— 新增 / 变更 / 相同 / 跳过 四类计数与文件清单。
5. **冲突策略三选**：
   - `overwrite` —— 用包内内容覆盖目标文件（默认）；
   - `skip` —— 保留目标文件，跳过冲突项；
   - `merge` —— 文本文件把包内内容**追加**到目标文件末尾（带分隔注释），已有内容绝不覆盖；非文本文件退化为覆盖。
6. **备份 → 原子替换 → 失败回滚** —— 每个被覆盖/追加的目标先备份到 `<packs>/.restore-backups/<时间戳>/`，包内内容先写成临时文件再 `rename` 原子替换；**任一环节失败即中止**，并按记录把本次已替换/已新增的文件回滚回去（计数随回滚归零，回滚数单独上报）。
7. 应用，按需重启 DSH。
与包内完全一致的文件在任何策略下都会自动跳过。JSON / YAML 等结构化配置**不支持 merge**（追加即损坏），请使用覆盖或手工合并。运行中的 SQLite 库（`*.db*`）默认跳过不恢复（避免覆盖记忆数据）。

```text
/pack list                                                 # 列出已有包（含 [加密] 标记）
/pack create [--modules skills,memory] [--mode migrate|share] [--note 备注] [--dry-run] [--encrypt 口令]
/pack create --share                                       # --share 是 --mode share 的简写
/pack restore <zip路径> [--strategy overwrite|skip|merge] [--modules a,b] [--include-db] [--password 口令]

| 命令 | 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | — | 列出已生成包：创建时间、大小、模块、备注、是否加密 |
| `create` | `--modules a,b` 按名选择模块；`--mode migrate\|share`（默认 `migrate`）；`--share` 简写；`--note 备注`；`--dry-run` 仅预览；`--encrypt 口令` | 不指定 `--modules` 时按模式预设自动选择（migrate = 全选；share = 只选 Skills） |
| `restore` | `<zip路径>`；`--strategy overwrite\|skip\|merge`；`--modules a,b` 只恢复指定模块；`--include-db` 连记忆真库一起恢复（需先停 DSH）；`--password 口令` | 导入 → 校验 → 差异 → 按策略应用；加密包必须给口令 |
| `scan` | — | 对所有可打包模块执行隐私扫描，报告敏感痕迹 |

包完整性校验不再单独开命令：设置页「查看」会在列出文件的同时重算 SHA-256，不一致项直接标红。

**输出目录**：打包结果写入 `~/.dsh/packs/`（`DSH_PACKS_DIR` 可覆盖）；文件名形如 `dsh-packer-<时间戳>-<随机后缀>-<模式>.zip`（唯一后缀保证同秒多次打包不互相覆盖），每次打包还会在同目录生成一个同名 `.json` 摘要文件（记录时间 / 模块 / 备注 / 文件数），供包列表与快速识别使用。恢复时的目标备份写入同目录下的 `.restore-backups/<时间戳>-<随机后缀>/`（可随时删除，列表与本插件都不会读它）。包列表、删除、重命名也可在设置页「配置打包」标签页操作。

| 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_PACKS_DIR` | `~/.dsh/packs` | 打包输出目录 |
| `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` | `~/.dsh/memory` | memory 模块数据位置 |
| `DSH_HOME` | `~/.dsh` | DSH 数据根目录（各模块路径基准） |

设置页按「配置打包器」的任务链组织成一页五个区块：**已有的配置包 → 打包内容 → 打包选项 → 恢复（含差异对比）→ 结果明细**。包信息、完整性校验、改名、删除（送当前平台的系统回收站，鸿蒙为永久删除并先提示）都在包列表行上；恢复前先看差异对比，选模块与策略后执行，完成页给出备份目录与一键撤回。界面中文单语、无图标字符，状态一律文字表达。

- **Node.js** ≥ 22.19.0
- **多平台通用**：Windows / macOS / Linux / 鸿蒙 共用同一套代码与包格式；回收站按平台分派（Windows 回收站 / macOS 废纸篓 / Linux Trash），鸿蒙仍有两项受限（回收站、系统文件选择框），原因与矩阵见 [docs/platform-support.md](docs/platform-support.md)。
- **DSH 版本闸门**：`engines.dsh` = `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`（0.2.1-rc.3 桌面版实测）。DSH 的兼容性检查带 `includePrerelease`，预发布号参与范围比较；超出该范围的 DSH 会在安装前被插件管理器拒绝。
- **peer 依赖**：`@deepseek-ai/cordis` ^4.0.2（插件生命周期基准，由宿主提供）；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 范围同 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，且**未被 `index.mjs` 直接 import**——本插件只使用 `ctx.commands` / `ctx.webServer` / `ctx.slots` 等宿主内建服务，故这两项在 `peerDependenciesMeta` 中标记为 `optional: true`。
- **无需外部命令**（打包/恢复全程）：包由 zip.mjs（node:zlib）直接读写，创建 / 列成员 / 解包都不调用 tar、bsdtar、unzip；任何标准解压工具都能打开生成的包。（只有「删除进回收站」会调系统命令：Windows PowerShell / macOS osascript；Linux 为纯 Node。）

**生成的 zip 打不开 / 提示损坏？**

包是纯 JS 生成的标准 zip，Windows 资源管理器与常见解压工具均可打开。若校验失败，请勿手工解压改动包内容（会破坏 `manifest.json` 里的 SHA-256 指纹），直接用 `/pack create` 重新生成。可用 `/pack list` 查看 `~/.dsh/packs`（或 `DSH_PACKS_DIR` 指向的目录）里有哪些包。

**恢复时 manifest 校验失败？**

通常是以下几种情况：该 zip 不是 dsh-packer 生成的（包内没有 `manifest.json`）、`manifest.json` 缺失或 `schemaVersion` 与当前版本不兼容、或包生成后被改动过。请重新分发原包或重新生成。

**分享包被拦截怎么办？**

分享模式**不因隐私命中而拦截**（命中一律强制脱敏后打包），真正会失败的只有两类：勾了分享预设不允许的模块（只有 `skills` 允许，其余返回 `share_scope`）；有文件读不出内容、没能经过扫描（fail-closed，响应里会列出是哪些文件）。前者去掉不该分享的模块即可；后者先处理那些文件（权限/占用/损坏）再重试。需要保真备份请用迁移模式（仅报告，不强制脱敏）。

**「合并」策略具体怎么工作？**

对文本文件：把包内内容**追加**到目标文件末尾，带分隔注释——已有内容绝不覆盖；非文本文件退化为覆盖；JSON / YAML 等结构化配置不支持合并（追加即损坏），请用覆盖或手工合并。与包内完全一致的文件在任何策略下都自动跳过。

**恢复报「已中止 / 已回滚」是什么意思？**

恢复是「整批或不做」的：任一环节（路径校验、指纹校验、写盘）失败就立即中止，并把本次已经替换/新增的文件按备份回滚回去——`已回滚 N` 表示回滚了多少个文件，失败原因在设置页的失败清单里逐条列出。备份留在 `<packs>/.restore-backups/` 下，可手工核对。

**为什么记忆数据库（`*.db*`）默认不被恢复？**

运行中的 SQLite 库被 DSH / 记忆插件持有，直接覆写可能损坏数据。所以本插件默认不打包也不恢复 `*.db`、`*.db-wal`、`*.db-shm`、`*.sqlite`，恢复时会把它计入「跳过」并单列原因。

要真的把记忆搬过去：**先退出 DSH**，在恢复页打开 `includeDb` 开关（或 `/pack restore <包> --include-db`）再执行。打包侧的记忆真库来自 `VACUUM INTO` 一致快照（`memoryDb` 模块），是完整可用的库。

**恢复报「清单条目缺少合法 SHA-256 指纹」？**

该包不是 dsh-packer 生成的、或 `manifest.json` 被手工改过。指纹缺失/格式非法一律拒绝恢复（fail-closed），请重新分发原包或重新生成。

**包存在哪里？**

默认 `~/.dsh/packs`，可用 `DSH_PACKS_DIR` 环境变量覆盖；每个包在同目录下还带一个同名 `.json` 摘要文件，便于识别与包列表展示。

```bash
npm test                          # node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"，37 个用例全绿
node scripts/release-check.mjs    # 发布一致性自检（版本号 / README 版本露出 / files 白名单 / git 状态）
```

**CI**：`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 在 Node 22.x / 24.x 上执行「发布自检 → 单元测试 → `npm pack --dry-run`」（本包零运行时依赖，无需安装步骤），推送与 PR 都会触发。

> **Agent Configuration Packer**: pack your local DSH assets into standard zip archives — migrate, share, restore, with a privacy scan guarding every pack.
>
> [简体中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md)

> **v0.7.2** · MIT License · DSH 0.2.x (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`, tested on the 0.2.1-rc.3 desktop app) · Node ≥ 22.19.0

**dsh-packer** is the Agent Configuration Packer plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: it packs your local Agent assets, module by module, into standard zip archives, for two purposes:

- **Migration** — move your entire setup to a new machine, or recover after a reinstall.
- **Sharing** — hand Skills and other assets to other people, with sensitive content filtered automatically.

Every module is optional (Skills / Sessions / Attachments / Profiles / Settings / Presets / Memory); restore ships with diff reports and conflict strategies, and a privacy scan guards every pack — all capabilities are opt-in.

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Modular packing | Nine modules, any combination: `skills` / `sessions` / `attachments` (**the bytes of images/files inside sessions**, on by default for migration) / `profiles` / `plugins` (**installed plugin bodies**, on by default for migration) / `settings` / `presets` / `memory` (Markdown mirror) / `memoryDb` (**consistent SQLite snapshot of the memory truth source**, on by default) |
| Two built-in presets | **Migrate** (everything, including installed plugin bodies and session attachments) / **Share** (Skills only; sessions, attachments, memory data, plugins and personal skill subdirectories are automatically excluded) |
| Privacy & security scan | Detects drive-letter / Unix / UNC paths, user-directory paths, credential assignments and bare key shapes (`sk-`, `ghp_`, `AKIA`, JWT, …), plus personal nicknames, counting **every occurrence**; **share mode force-sanitizes every hit (it never blocks on a hit), migrate mode reports only** |
| File-level operation preview | Full file list preview before packing; diff report before restore (added / changed / same / skipped) |
| Three conflict strategies | Overwrite / skip / merge (merge appen

readme.section: Desktop app: install by package name (recommended)
readme.text:
1. Open the DSH desktop app → **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**;
2. Type the package name `dsh-packer` and click **Install** (it is enabled automatically).

CLI equivalent:

```bash

readme.section: replace desktop with your profile name
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-packer
```
```bash

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:KLRSL/dsh-packer
```
```bash

dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-packer
```

`dsh plugin` registers the package into `dsh.profile.bundles` and mounts the patch automatically; restart DSH afterwards.

**Verify the install**:

1. Open **Settings → the "Config Packer" tab** — you should see the module checkboxes and the pack list.
2. Or run `/pack list` in the terminal — an empty list (or "no packs yet") means the command registered fine.
3. Run `/pack create --dry-run` once — it previews the file list and scan results without producing a zip, confirming the module paths are readable.
```bash

readme.section: 1. Create a migrate pack (everything selected by default)
readme.text: /pack create --note "moving to a new machine"

readme.section: 2. Or create a share pack (Skills only, sensitive content excluded)
readme.text: /pack create --share --note "for a friend"

readme.section: 3. Preview first without generating a zip
readme.text:
/pack create --mode migrate --dry-run
```

When it finishes, the zip is written to `~/.dsh/packs/` (override with `DSH_PACKS_DIR`); share packs automatically include a `README.md`.
```bash
/pack restore ~/.dsh/packs/dsh-packer-2026-09-05-223045-migrate.zip

readme.section: 3. Pick a conflict strategy: overwrite | skip | merge
readme.text:
/pack restore <zip-path> --strategy merge
```

`manifest.json` is validated automatically (schemaVersion + fingerprint validity + every source file's SHA-256) before anything is applied; each target is backed up first and swapped in atomically, and a failure aborts the batch and rolls it back. Restart DSH if needed afterwards.

| Module | Contents | Migrate preset | Share preset |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `skills` | Skills (including the memory-mechanism skill), under `~/.dsh/skills` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sessions` | Session records (`.zstd` format), under `~/.dsh/sessions` | ✅ | ❌ |
| `attachments` | **Session attachment object store**: the bytes of images/files inside sessions (content-addressed, under `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects`; excludes the rebuildable request-image cache and the `tmp` staging area) | ✅ | ❌ |
| `profiles` | Profile configs (excluding `node_modules`), under `~/.dsh/profiles` | ✅ | ❌ |
| `plugins` | **Installed plugin bodies** (top-level package directories in `profiles/<profile>/node_modules`); large | ✅ | ❌ |
| `settings` | Global settings (`settings.yaml`) | ✅ | ❌ |
| `presets` | Agent presets (`.agent-presets`) | ✅ | ❌ |
| `memory` | **Memory mirror** (human-readable Markdown under `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` or `~/.dsh/memory`, excluding `backups/`) | ✅ | ❌ |
| `memoryDb` | **Memory truth source** (`<DSH_BIOMEMORY_DIR \|\| ~/.dsh/biomemory>/biomemory.db`): packed as a **consistent `VACUUM INTO` snapshot** (read-only connection, never touches a live WAL database); on failure the file is left o

**Session images live in `attachments`**: session logs only store an `attachmentId` reference (`sha256:<64hex>`); the bytes live under `~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects`. Packing `sessions` alone would leave images broken after a restore (the history opens, but the image bytes are missing), so the **"Session records" group** in the settings page packs `sessions` + `attachments` together. Objects are content-addressed, so the target machine needs no reference rewriting.

**The two built-in presets**:

- **Migrate** — every module checked by default: ideal for relocating a whole environment.
- **Share** — only `skills` is checked; sessions, attachments and memory data are excluded automatically, and personal skill subdirectories (`_shared`) are also excluded, keeping sensitive content out of the pack as much as possible.
**Scan rules** (scope: files with known text extensions plus extensionless files that are clearly text, e.g. `.env`; binaries containing NUL bytes are skipped):

| Rule | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Local absolute paths (drive letter) | Drive-letter style paths such as `D:\...`, `C:/...` |
| Unix home paths | `/home/<name>/...`, `/Users/<name>/...`, `/root/...` — **home directories only** (the path says whose machine it is). `/usr`, `/etc`, `/var`, `/opt`, `/srv`, `/mnt`, `/media` and `/tmp` are shared system paths with no personal information: since v0.7.0 they are **neither reported nor sanitized** |
| UNC / network paths | `\\server\share\...` |
| User-directory paths | Paths under the OS user profile directory (`C:\Users\<name>`, `/home/<name>`, `/Users/<name>`); mount prefixes in front of the home directory are consumed too (`/System/Volumes/Data/Users/<name>/…`, `/Volumes/<volume>/Users/<name>/…`, `/mnt|media/<name>/Users/<name>/…`), so no half-sanitized prefix is left behind |
| Mount / derived paths | `/Volumes/<volume>`, `/System/Volumes/Data`, `/private`, `/nix/store` — these are **machine-specific** (volume names are user-chosen, `/private` carries a per-machine hash, `/nix/store` exposes the local package layout), unlike `/usr` or `/etc`, which are identical on every machine. Replaced with `<本机路径>`, sub-path kept |
| Suspected
Counts are tallied per file + rule + line, so multiple hits on one line are all counted (no more "one hit per rule per file").

Scan cache: "Preview" and "Pack" both hit the same `/create` endpoint; the backend caches scan results by **file name + content SHA-256**, so the same content is never read and matched twice. **Change the content and the fingerprint changes, forcing a re-scan** — this is a performance optimization, not a correctness trade-off (calls without a SHA-256 are never cached, and editing the deployer's personal patterns invalidates the whole cache).

**Blocking policy**:

- **Share mode** — a hit is **never blocked, but sanitizing is forced**: the `sanitize` flag sent by the UI is ignored and every pack is sanitized (paths become placeholders, credentials become `<已移除的密钥>`; only the copy inside the pack changes, source files are untouched). Share packs are meant for others, so content is rewritten rather than passed through. Two things *do* fail a share pack: selecting a module the share preset forbids (**only `skills` is allowed**; anything else → `share_scope`), and files whose content cannot be read and therefore never went through the scan (fail-closed, the file list is reported).
- **Migrate mode** — hits are reported only; inspect them in advance with `/pack scan` or `--dry-run` and decide yourself, or opt into "sanitize before packing".

**Never packed**: `.credentials.yaml` and `.anonymous-user-id` are skipped in every module's file walk, regardless of mode — local identity/credential files never enter a pack.

Other security measures:

- Every file's **SHA-256** fingerprint is recorded in `manifest.json` for fail-closed integrity checks on restore; entries **without a well-formed fingerprint are rejected**, and files whose hash cannot be computed are skipped at pack time and reported (a blank fingerprint is never written).
- Restore containment is **two-sided**: the source must stay inside the extraction directory and the target must stay inside its module root (zip-slip / tampered manifests with `../` escapes are rejected). Absolute paths, drive-letter paths, UNC paths and `..` segments are rejected by a whitelist before restore even starts.
- Before unpacking, archive members are enumerated from the ZIP central directory by the plugin's own reader (no external commands) and whitelisted (absolute / drive-letter / UNC / `..` names rejected), and symlink / hardlink / device members are refused; the extracted tree is scanned again for symlinks. Temporary extraction directories are always cleaned up in `try/finally` — on success and on failure.
- Targets are backed up first (`<packs>/.restore-backups/<timestamp>/`), written to a temp file and swapped in with an atomic `rename`; any failure aborts and rolls back what

Since **v0.2.6 the memory truth source is in the pack**: the `memoryDb` module stores a consistent `VACUUM INTO` snapshot of
`<DSH_BIOMEMORY_DIR || ~/.dsh/biomemory>/biomemory.db` (entries plus audit records) instead of copying a live, DSH-held WAL database —
a plain copy of a live WAL database would not be safe, hence the snapshot. If the snapshot cannot be taken the file is skipped and
listed under `unreadable` rather than silently dropped.

| Module | Contents | Enough for migration? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryDb` | **`VACUUM INTO` consistent snapshot** of `biomemory.db` (entries + audit) | ✅ the memory itself |
| `memory` | Read-only Markdown mirror under `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT`, meant for humans | ⚠️ readable copy only |

Restore still skips `*.db*` by default (`includeDb: true` writes them) so a memory database in use on the target machine is never
overwritten — **stop DSH before restoring** if you want `memoryDb` written back.

- SQLite is handled on both sides: **packing** takes a consistent `VACUUM INTO` snapshot (`memoryDb`, since v0.2.6) instead of copying a live, DSH-held WAL database (failure means the file is skipped and listed under `unreadable`); **restore** still skips `*.db*` by default (`includeDb: true` writes them) so a memory database in use on the target machine is never overwritten.
- Pack file names carry a unique suffix (`dsh-packer-<timestamp>-<random>-<mode>.zip`) so packs created within the same second never overwrite each other.
- Packs are built by the plugin own **pure-JS ZIP writer** (zip.mjs, node:zlib) — standard zips with **zero native npm dependencies and no external commands**.
- All file and subprocess work is asynchronous (`node:fs/promises` + `execFile`), with bounded concurrency (16 by default) for hashing and copying, so packing large trees never blocks DSH's event loop.

The Settings tab is a peer of the `/pack` command and talks to the plugin's own prefix route, `/packer/api/*`. That route is **fail-closed** by default, and the checks run in the order "rate limit → auth → body size → routing", with all three gates completed **before the request body is buffered**:

| Item | Default | Behaviour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Auth | `api.authMode: 'auto'` | **Official mechanism only**: `requestRejection(req)` on `ctx.get('connection')` (dsh-client-connection) — the same Host/Origin trust plus signed browser session check the official `/api` channel uses. `401` → 401, `403` → 403, only `undefined` lets the request through |
| Auth service unavailable | **Hard 403** | If the `connection` service is missing, has no `requestRejection`, or throws, the request is rejected with 403 and a reason; the plugin **never silently falls back** to a weaker path (the built-in token channel requires opting in with `authMode: 'token'`) |
| Rate limit | 60 / 60 s | **Outermost**: a sliding window keyed by client address (`remoteAddress`), evaluated before auth and before reading the body, so unauthenticated traffic consumes the same quota. Over the limit: 429 with `retry-after`; the key table is bounded (no timers, bounded memory) |
| Body size limit | 8 MB | Decided **before the body is fully buffered**: a declared `Content-Length` over the limit is rejected with 413 without reading a single byte; without a length the body is counted while streaming and the connection i

| Option | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `authMode` | `'auto'` | `'auto'`: official `connection` only, 403 when unavailable; `'token'`: **explicit opt-in** plugin-owned fallback — Host / Origin / `Sec-Fetch-Site` same-origin checks plus a one-time token (generated at `apply` time, injected into the same-origin `index.html` via `webServer.tapIndex`; the UI sends it as the `x-dsh-packer-token` header), for hosts that genuinely have no `connection` service; `'off'`: **insecure**, isolated tests only |

| `rateLimit` / `rateWindowMs` | `60` / `60000` | Rate-limit count and window (ms) |

`authMode: 'off'` and an explicitly pinned `token` hand the security decision to the deployer; they are documented so you know what you opted into, not because they are recommended.

1. **Import the zip** — pick the file in the Settings tab, or `/pack restore <zip-path>`.
2. **Archive validation** — members are listed and whitelisted first (absolute / drive-letter / UNC / `..` / link-type members rejected), then `manifest.json` is read.
3. **Manifest validation** — `manifest.json` exists, its schemaVersion is compatible, every entry has a well-formed SHA-256 fingerprint, and every source file's hash matches; any mismatch is **fail-closed**.
4. **Diff report** — added / changed / same / skipped counts and file lists.
5. **Pick a conflict strategy**:
   - `overwrite` — replace the target file with the pack's content (default);
   - `skip` — keep the target file and skip conflicting entries;
   - `merge` — for text files, **append** the pack's content to the end of the target behind a separator comment; existing content is never overwritten. Non-text files fall back to overwrite.
6. **Backup → atomic swap → rollback on failure** — every target that will be replaced or appended to is backed up to `<packs>/.restore-backups/<timestamp>/` first, and the pack's content is written to a temp file and swapped in with an atomic `rename`; **any failure aborts the batch** an

Files already identical to the pack are skipped automatically under every strategy. **Merge is not supported for structured configs** (JSON/YAML) — appending corrupts them; use overwrite or merge manually. Live SQLite databases (`*.db*`) are skipped by default to avoid overwriting memory data.

/pack create --share                                       # --share is shorthand for --mode share
/pack restore <zip-path> [--strategy overwrite|skip|merge] [--modules a,b] [--include-db] [--password passphrase]

| Command | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | — | Lists generated packs: creation time, size, included modules, note, encryption flag |
| `create` | `--modules a,b` pick modules by name; `--mode migrate\|share` (default `migrate`); `--share` shorthand; `--note note`; `--dry-run` preview only; `--encrypt passphrase` | Without `--modules`, modules follow the mode preset (migrate = all; share = Skills only) |

Pack verification no longer has its own command: the settings page's "Browse" recomputes SHA-256 while listing files and flags mismatches in red.

**Output directory**: packs are written to `~/.dsh/packs/` (override with `DSH_PACKS_DIR`); names look like `dsh-packer-<timestamp>-<random>-<mode>.zip` (the unique suffix keeps same-second packs from overwriting each other), and each pack also gets a same-name `.json` summary file in the same directory (time / modules / note / file count) for the list view and quick identification. Restore backups go to `.restore-backups/<timestamp>-<random>/` in that same directory (safe to delete at any time; neither the list nor the plugin reads it). Pack list, delete and rename are also available in the Settings → "Config Packer" tab.

| `DSH_PACKS_DIR` | `~/.dsh/packs` | Pack output directory |
| `DSH_MEMORY_ROOT` | `~/.dsh/memory` | Location of the `memory` module data |

The Settings page is one page in five blocks, following the packer's task chain: **existing packs → contents to pack → pack options → restore (with per-item diff) → result details**. Pack info, integrity verification, rename and delete live on the pack row (delete sends the pack to the platform's own trash — on HarmonyOS it is permanent and announced first); restore shows the diff first, then module selection and strategy, and the result block reports the backup directory with a one-click rollback. **The zip won't open / looks corrupted?**

Packs are standard zips created by the plugin pure-JS ZIP writer — Windows Explorer and common unzip tools can open them. If a pack fails validation, don't hand-edit its contents (that breaks the SHA-256 fingerprints in `manifest.json`); regenerate it with `/pack create`. Check `~/.dsh/packs` (or your `DSH_PACKS_DIR`) with `/pack list` to see what's there.

**Manifest validation fails on restore?**

Usually one of: the zip was not created by dsh-packer (no `manifest.json` inside), `manifest.json` is missing or its schemaVersion is incompatible with the current version, or the pack was modified after creation. Redistribute the original pack or regenerate it.

**My share pack got blocked — what now?**

Share mode does **not** abort on privacy hits — hits are always sanitized before packing. Only two things fail a share pack: selecting a module the share preset forbids (only `skills` is allowed; anything else returns `share_scope`), and files whose content cannot be read and therefore never went through the scan (fail-closed — the response lists them). For the first, drop the module that should not be shared; for the second, fix those files (permissions, lock, corruption) and retry. Use migrate mode when you need a faithful backup (report-only, no forced sanitizing).

**How does the merge strategy work?**

For text files, the pack's content is **appended** to the target file behind a separator comment — existing content is never overwritten. Non-text files fall back to overwrite; structured configs (JSON/YAML) don't support merging at all (appending corrupts them) — use overwrite or merge manually. Files already identical to the pack are skipped under every strategy.

**What does "aborted / rolled back" on restore mean?**

Restore is all-or-nothing: if any step (path validation, fingerprint check, writing) fails, it stops immediately and rolls back the files this run already replaced or added, using the backups taken moments earlier. `rolled back N` reports how many files were restored; failure reasons are listed entry by entry in the Settings tab. Backups stay under `<packs>/.restore-backups/` for manual inspection.

**Why wasn't my memory database (`*.db*`) restored?**

Live SQLite databases are held open by DSH / the memory plugin, so overwriting them can corrupt data. The plugin neither packs nor restores `*.db`, `*.db-wal`, `*.db-shm` or `*.sqlite` by default; on restore they are counted as skipped with an explicit reason.

To actually move memory across: **quit DSH first**, then enable the `includeDb` toggle on the restore tab (or `/pack restore <pack> --include-db`). The packed database comes from a consistent `VACUUM INTO` snapshot (the `memoryDb` module), so it is complete and usable.

**Restore says "entry is missing a valid SHA-256 fingerprint"?**

The pack was not generated by dsh-packer, or its `manifest.json` was hand-edited. Missing or malformed fingerprints are rejected outright (fail-closed) — redistribute the original pack or regenerate it.

**Where are packs stored?**

`~/.dsh/packs` by default, overridable via the `DSH_PACKS_DIR` environment variable; each pack also has a same-name `.json` summary file in the same directory for identification and the list view.
